title: Pessoa Supervisora Trade Execução - Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro
description:
Pessoa Supervisora Trade Execução - Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro

Join to apply for the role of Pessoa Supervisora Trade Execução - Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro at The HEINEKEN Company.

Missão do cargo

Responsável pela negociação e implementação das estratégias de trade junto aos clientes de off premise, atuando como gestor da equipe de promotores, supervisionando e desenvolvendo esses profissionais para executar com sucesso as nossas marcas no mercado, visando maximizar os negócios dos clientes e da Heineken Brasil.

Principais atribuições

  • Assegurar a excelência na execução das estratégias definidas para o canal na sua região (Fotografia de sucesso) através do acompanhamento in loco da execução das atividades nas lojas de AS e acompanhamento de pesquisas de mercado;
  • Identificar e desenvolver oportunidades de negócios, visando o incremento de volume, espaço e crescimento do mix de segmentados nos clientes potenciais, através de visita/prospecção destes clientes no mercado;
  • Assegurar o cadastro de todos os produtos contemplados no mix dentro das lojas de sua responsabilidade, respeitando o guia de FDS para marcas e embalagens prioritárias e sugeridas;
  • Garantir que a equipe de promotores tenha condições de implementar as ações de trade marketing, ativando os pontos de vendas, através da gestão do estoque mínimo, aplicação dos materiais promocionais, negociação de espaço e cumprimento das contrapartidas acordadas;
  • Garantir que o estoque virtual dos clientes esteja zerado, através do acompanhamento da ferramenta de gestão, evitando ruptura de nossos produtos no PDV;
  • Monitorar o cumprimento das políticas de preço, através do acompanhamento in loco, visando informar eventuais desvios de preço e atuar nas correções, quando possível;
  • Assegurar a valorização da marca dos nossos produtos no ponto de venda, através da aplicação correta dos materiais de merchandising e coordenação das atividades promocionais implementadas nos clientes;
  • Supervisionar e desenvolver a equipe de promotores com intuito de capacitá-los a executar as diretrizes de execução das nossas marcas, garantindo conhecimento técnico e cumprimento das rotinas estabelecidas;
  • Realizar rotas regulares no mercado em todas as lojas da carteira, visando o acompanhamento da execução através de coaching ao promotor e da avaliação de loja (FDS);
  • Acompanhar o resultado das ações implantadas dentro do canal sugerindo melhorias sempre que necessário;
  • Análises de sell in e sell out por Rede/Lojas/Rotas ou análises especiais (conforme necessário ou identificado);
  • Gestão dos ativos da Cia junto ao mercado (Refrigeradores / Racks / Beer box/ Demais Materiais permanentes).

Formação acadêmica

Superior cursando, sendo 70% do curso já completo.

Requisitos

  • Ter CNH B ativa e definitiva
  • Excel Intermediário
  • Experiência com gestão de pessoas

Benefícios

Oferecemos cuidado com a saúde com assistência médica, odontológica, telemedicina, cartão Farmácia, seguro de vida e previdência privada. Programas de apoio psicológico, orientação jurídica e financeira, Gympass, Programa de Gestantes com licença maternidade de 180 dias e paternidade de até 30 dias, vale alimentação e vale refeição, vale transporte, loja exclusiva para colaboradores (Heistore) e oportunidades de desenvolvimento pela Universidade HEINEKEN, parcerias educacionais e programa de idiomas. Programa interno Be Leader para liderança.

NÃO HÁ INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS RELEVANTES AO CARGO.

title: Psicólogo - Supervisor ABA
description:
MISSÃO

Desenvolver, supervisionar e garantir a eficácia dos padrões clínicos e das intervenções baseadas em Análise do Comportamento Aplicada (ABA) na Jano Saúde, promovendo a qualidade dos atendimentos, a formação da equipe clínica e a adesão às melhores práticas com base em evidências científicas. Atua também como facilitador da coordenação do cuidado e da integração com famílias, escolas e equipes interdisciplinares.

ATIVIDADES

Acolhida/contato inicial com o aprendiz, família, escola e equipe multidisciplinar

  • Realizar acolhimento inicial de famílias e indivíduos neuro divergentes, escutando e legitimando queixas e expectativas para alinhamento com a intervenção proposta.
  • Coletar e selecionar informações do histórico do indivíduo e da família, assim como dados de equipes multidisciplinares e escolas, para o delineamento da intervenção.
  • Esclarecer possíveis dúvidas que a família, escola ou equipe multidisciplinar possam ter sobre a intervenção.

Avaliação comportamental e desenvolvimento do plano de tratamento individualizado (PTI)

  • Planejar e realizar avaliação de repertório, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida.
  • Planejar e realizar avaliações funcionais.
  • Redigir relatórios de avaliação e protocolos, programas ou procedimentos individualizados de ensino de habilidades, prevenção e redução de problemas de comportamento do aprendiz com base na função.
  • Realizar reavaliação de repertório a cada 4 meses.
  • Realizar reavaliação de repertório, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida a cada 1 ano.
  • Definir carga horária e local de tratamento do cliente.

Intervenção

  • Confeccionar o plano de intervenção individualizado (PTI) do aprendiz.
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento de materiais instrucionais (programas e descrição de procedimentos) e folhas de registro necessárias para a implementação da intervenção.
  • Supervisionar no mínimo 10% da carga horária de intervenção, distribuídas em horas de supervisão diretas e indiretas.
  • Avaliar o progresso dos comportamentos na intervenção a partir da análise dos dados sistematizados e/ou observação direta (na presença e na ausência do aprendiz).
  • Realizar relatórios de evolução mensal para plano de saúde quando necessário.
  • Acompanhar os planos de transição entre equipes, desligamento ou alta do aprendiz.
  • Redigir documentos como pautas e atas de reuniões realizadas com familiares e equipe.
  • Modificar ou descontinuar do serviço prestado, baseado na avaliação dos riscos e benefícios de continuar a intervenção ou substituí-la por práticas alternativas, estando a decisão formalizada em prontuário/ficha de atendimento do aprendiz.

Coordenação, monitoramento e treinamento

  • Avaliar e prover feedback do desempenho da equipe de intervenção comportamental e familiares na implementação dos procedimentos delineados para o aprendiz.
  • Realizar orientação e treino parental.
  • Coordenar, orientar e treinar a equipe de intervenção, os familiares, cuidadores e outras pessoas significativas, a implementar os programas e procedimentos delineados, na presença e na ausência do aprendiz.
  • Realizar comunicação e treinamento, quando necessário, da equipe de coordenação de cuidado.
ESCOLARIDADE / FORMAÇÃO
  • Ensino superior em psicologia, com carteira do conselho ativa.
  • Pós graduação completa em análise do comportamento aplicada ao TEA.
  • Ter obtido título de mestre ou doutor em análise do comportamento ou áreas associadas ao desenvolvimento atípico (diferencial).
  • Certificação em procedimento de gerenciamento de crises agressivas (diferencial).
EXPERIÊNCIA PROFISSIONAL
  • Experiência anterior como supervisor ABA acima de 1 ano.

title: Engineering Manager, Ubuntu Server - cloud-init
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Ubuntu Server is the world’s most popular Linux distribution for cloud and bare metal. In this role, you will manage the team delivering cloud-init – the standard for customizing cloud instances – to the world.

Cloud-init supports various distributions and underlying platforms. This provides an opportunity to work with cloud providers to add features and integrations, the cloud-init community, and distributions to update builds and coordinate needs. You will own the product, influence its evolution, and interact with many teams and partners to coordinate new features, enhancements, and integration into various platforms.

The successful applicant will be passionate about the future of cloud-init, mindful of the dynamics of the open source ecosystem, and aware of the needs of large, innovative customers. This is an exciting opportunity for a leader who values strong teams, open source software, and Ubuntu.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. We recruit on a global basis and operate with a distributed team across 75+ countries.

What you'll do
  • Build and lead a globally distributed team of engineers
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development
  • Work with Product Management to define the vision and strategy for Ubuntu and your team
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern, agile software development practices
  • Develop and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders
  • Participate in strong engineering processes through code and architectural reviews
  • Engage with teams at Canonical, the open source community, and commercial partners
  • Oversee the quality of the Ubuntu Server image family
  • Plan and deliver Ubuntu Server features
  • Work from home with global travel for up to 6 weeks per year for internal and external events
Who you are
  • You love developing and growing people and have a strong track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You have 3+ years of experience in leading, managing, coaching and mentoring software developers. Experience managing distributed teams is a plus.
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have experience working in an agile development environment
  • You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have strong written and verbal technical communication skills in English
  • You have experience with a modern GNU/Linux distribution; Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • You have practical experience with at least one of Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or Amazon Web Services
What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits reflecting our values and ideals. We balance programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we recruit on a global basis and set a high standard for people joining the company. Canonical has been remote-first since 2004. We expect excellence and strive to be the best at what we do. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination, and we will give your application fair consideration.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer.

RINA is currently recruiting for a Senior Asset Integrity RBI Engineer to join its office in Rio de Janeiro within theOperations and Maintenance Engineering Division.

Mission

The Senior Asset Integrity RBI Engineer plays a pivotal role in optimizing inspection strategies within the Oil & Gas facilities or power plant by implementing risk-based inspection methodologies. Their mission is to assess the integrity of equipment and facilities, prioritize inspection activities based on risk assessment, and develop cost-effective inspection plans to ensure asset reliability, safety, and regulatory compliance. #LI-KM

Key Accountabilities

Risk Assessment and Analysis:

  • Conduct risk assessments of equipment and infrastructure using RBI methodologies.
  • Identify and evaluate potential failure modes, consequences, and likelihood of failure.
  • Analyze risk data to prioritize inspection activities according to risk levels.

Inspection Planning and Optimization:

  • Develop risk-based inspection plans tailored to specific equipment and process units.
  • Determine appropriate inspection techniques, frequencies, and inspection intervals based on risk assessment results.
  • Optimize inspection schedules to minimize downtime and maximize asset integrity.

Data Management and Documentation:

  • Maintain comprehensive records of inspection data, risk assessments, and inspection plans.
  • Utilize software tools and databases to manage RBI data and documentation effectively.
  • Ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of RBI data for informed decision-making.

Continuous Improvement and Compliance:

  • Identify opportunities for optimization and improvement of RBI processes and methodologies.
  • Stay abreast of industry developments, best practices, and regulatory requirements related to RBI and asset integrity management.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant safety standards, codes, and regulations governing inspection activities.

Communication and Collaboration:

  • Communicate RBI findings, recommendations, and inspection plans to stakeholders, including engineering teams, inspection and asset integrity personnel, and management.
  • Foster a culture of safety, reliability, and continuous improvement within the organization.
Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering General or Chemical Engineering

Qualifications
  • Extensive experience in risk-based inspection, integrity management, or asset reliability engineering within the Oil & Gas facilities or power plant industry.
  • Proficiency in RBI methodologies, such as API RP 580/581, ASME PCC-3, or equivalent standards,
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and perform risk assessments.
  • Familiarity with inspection techniques, non-destructive testing (NDT) methods, and fitness-for-service assessment.
  • Knowledge of relevant industry codes, standards, and regulations, such as API, ASME, and OSHA.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on quality, accuracy, and compliance in all aspects of work.
  • Ceritification in API 571 and API 580 is considered an added value.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English. Spanish is desirable.

Join to apply for the Software Platform Engineering Manager - Ubuntu for Next-Gen Silicon role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring engineering managers who are passionate about operational systems, open source technologies and cutting-edge hardware to lead engineering teams to enable and optimize Ubuntu for the latest x86, ARM, RISC-V, s390x and POWER systems.

We partner with the world's leading silicon vendors to optimise Ubuntu on their latest platforms. We integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements in Ubuntu while also ensuring a common operating experience for their users.

Engineering Managers should be outstanding developers themselves. They should be completely at home reviewing a patch or a software design spec. You will be expected to drive healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisations as well as lead your team to deliver high-quality design and code.

An Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team and product from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role.

You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco‑friendly practices in state‑of‑the‑art, geo‑diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer‑to‑peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting‑edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top‑tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

This role involves leading development of a secure, user‑friendly Linux operating system built on Wayland, MicroVMs and immutability principles and be compatible across diverse devices—from desktops to smart watches. It emphasizes security comparable to Qubes OS through virtualization and compartmentalization, while prioritizing convenience and ease of use. As the lead developer, you will initiate and guide the project from its foundational stages.

Responsibilities
  • Lead and mentor a team of Linux developers, ensuring high code quality, adherence to open source practices, and kernel development standards.
  • Design and implement core OS components, including kernel modifications, user‑space tools, and system integrations for robustness, security, and performance.
  • Collaborate with hardware and security teams to ensure seamless integration and broad device compatibility.
  • Partner with a project manager to define technical roadmaps, prioritize tasks, and achieve project milestones, identifying risks and implementing solutions promptly.
  • Provide hands‑on leadership to bootstrap the project, including initial development, recruiting key personnel, and fostering open source community engagement.
  • Conduct code and architecture reviews to optimize for stability, performance, and hardware compatibility.
  • Stay informed on advancements in the Linux ecosystem, kernel developments, and relevant tools, incorporating innovations as appropriate.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Demonstrated leadership in Linux distributions, kernel contributions, or related open source projects (e.g., GNOME, systemd).
  • At least 6 years of hands‑on experience in Linux OS development, including kernel programming, distribution packaging, and low‑level system development in C/C++.
  • Proven track record in building open source communities and managing partnerships.
  • Essential experience with immutability (e.g., atomic updates), containerization (e.g., Docker, Podman), virtualization (e.g., QEMU, KVM, Xen for security isolation), Wayland compositing, and cross‑device portability.
  • Strong understanding of operating system principles, security models (e.g., SELinux, AppArmor), and hardware‑software interfaces.
  • Excellent leadership, problem‑solving, and communication skills.
Highly desirable experience
  • Prior experience leading Linux engineering teams and collaborating with open source communities, as well as knowledge of distributed systems or embedded Linux.
Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third‑party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double‑check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io.
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

description:
Membership&Supply Chain Officer, LATAM & Portugal

Starting Date: ASAP

Contract type: Full-time and open-ended

Salary : R$146,581 commensurate with relevant experience and skills

About the Job

Better Cotton Initiative (BCI) is the world’s largest cotton sustainability initiative – we support more sustainable farming practices and farm livelihoods for nearly 3 million farmers in the Better Cotton network in 23 countries around the world. BCI works across all farm sizes and geographies. It is crucial that Better Cotton producers, and the cotton they produce, can continue to access international markets in the face of changing regulatory and business expectations. Are you purpose-led and ready to embark on a journey to shape the future of sustainable cotton? Join us at Better Cotton as Membership& Supply ChainOfficer, LATAM & Portugal and support member engagement and the implementation of Better Cotton’s supply chain systems across the LATAM and Portugal region.

The Challenge

Looking ahead to 2030, we are targeting reducing GHG emissions from cotton production by half, big cuts in synthetic pesticide use, improving soil health across our network, improving farm income and supporting women’s empowerment among farmers and farm workers.

As Membership & Supply Chain Officer, you will be responsible for supporting members and supply chain actors to achieve their Better Cotton sourcing targets by enabling access to the Better Cotton Platform, delivering insights through reporting, and supporting stakeholder engagement processes, training and events, which contribute to systemic change towards more sustainable cotton production. You will provide high quality administrative support to the LATAM/Portugal Team, and support reporting for the region.

Areas that play to your strengths

We are seeking a motivated Membership & Supply Chain Officer to join our Membership and Supply Chain Team.

Membership Engagement & Support
  • Recruit and onboard new members and suppliers.
  • Guide applicants through documentation, cotton consumption calculations, and compliance steps.
  • Maintain member accounts and process applications using Salesforce and assist members with annual cotton consumption reporting.
  • Respond to stakeholder queries via Helpdesk and escalate when needed.
  • Support external communications and awareness of Better Cotton initiatives.
Supply Chain Operations
  • Monitor and troubleshoot account creation and transaction processes.
  • Clean and validate data to ensure system accuracy and compliance.
  • Compile and analyze KPIs (e.g., uptake rates, inventory structures).
  • Deliver supplier training programs (online and in-person).
  • Collaborate with internal teams to improve tools and processes.
Reporting & Administration
  • Provide high-quality administrative support to the LATAM/Portugal team.
  • Support regional reporting and performance monitoring.
  • Translate and adapt tools and documents for cultural and linguistic relevance.
We are looking for someone who has
  • Customer service orientation – for account creation, data validation, and stakeholder management.
  • Data analysis and reporting – Excel advanced functions.
  • Event and training organization and delivery – for organizing and delivering online and in-person training programs and stakeholder events.
  • Documentation and compliance review – for onboarding and membership processing.
  • Helpdesk systems and procedures – for managing stakeholder queries.
  • Sustainability and textile industry knowledge – understanding Better Cotton’s mission and practices.
  • Multilingual communication – ideally Spanish, Portuguese, and English.
  • Effective communication
  • Collaboration and adaptability
  • Problem-solving and attention to detail
  • Time management
  • Power BI or similar tool
  • Chain of Custody and Traceability
  • Initiative and ownership
What we offer
  • Remote work and flexible working arrangements
  • The opportunity to work from anywhere in the world for up to one month per year
  • Continuous learning and development
  • Life Insurance
  • Medical Insurance
  • Meal Voucher Allowance
  • 13 th Salary (Bonus) – Paid in 2 instalments Nov/Dec (Additional)
  • Legal protections of Local Labour Law
  • All other Better Cotton Global Policies apply (including enhancements)
  • 25 days paid annual leave, plus 8-9 Bank Holidays and a further 3 discretionary days off over Christmas/year end period.
  • A warm, positive working environment where everyone is valued
  • The opportunity to make your mark and make a difference.
Working arrangements

The position is full-time (40 hours per week), offers flexible working arrangements, and will be based remotely in Brazil. The role will be hired through an employer of record acting on behalf of Better Cotton. The role requires occasional travel to meet the team and some stakeholders (up to 15%).

Apply now

Send us your CV (2 pages maximum) and a brief cover letter (1-page maximum) by or before via this link.

In your cover letter, please include an explanation of why your experience is specifically relevant to this role at Better Cotton. We want to see your personal style – what makes you tick and why you think your next opportunity is here with us.

Better Cotton does not use artificial intelligence or automated screening tools in its hiring process. Every application is reviewed by our People & Culture team and relevant hiring managers to ensure a fair and human-led assessment experience.

Our hiring process

Initial Screening:

Applicant screening is a crucial step in our recruitment process. This stage may involve a brief phone interview or video call to evaluate your suitability for the position. During this screening, we review resumes and cover letters, and may conduct initial background checks to narrow down the pool of applicants. Internal candidates are encouraged to inform their line manager about their application to promote transparency and help facilitate a smooth transition if selected.

Interviews:

If you successfully pass the initial screening, you will be invited for interviews. The interview process at Better Cotton may include one or more rounds of interviews with various stakeholders, such as the hiring manager, team members, and potentially senior management. As an internal candidate, you may have discussions regarding your current responsibilities and how they will transition to the new position.

Assessment and Testing:

Depending on the role, you might be required to complete assessments, technical tests, or skills evaluations to gauge your competency and suitability for the position. Internal candidates may have the option to demonstrate their existing skills through current job performance or past project outcomes.

Reference Checks:

Once you progress further in the process, reference checks are conducted to validate your work history, skills, and qualifications, and for some roles, your education and criminal history. Internal candidates may be asked for references from current or previous supervisors within Better Cotton to provide insights into their performance and capabilities.

After completing interviews, assessments, and reference checks, the hiring team evaluates your performance and fit for the role. If you are selected and your references are relevant and satisfactory, you will receive a formal job offer letter outlining the terms of employment, compensation, benefits, and any other relevant details. For internal candidates, the offer process may include a discussion about how your transition to the new role will be managed and any support needed for a smooth handover.

About Better Cotton

Better Cotton is a global not-for-profit organization supporting the production of more equitable and sustainable cotton at farm level. We exist to catalyse the cotton farming community with partners, governments and others to continuously drive positive impact by setting standards and facilitating the supply and demand of more sustainable cotton from farm to brand. In just 15 years we have aligned more than a fifth of the world’s cotton with our standard and helped farmers and farming communities thrive. Join us in building a better, more sustainable future for cotton worldwide.

About our Values

The post holder will be expected to operate in line with our workplace values which are:

  • Trustworthy (including honest, transparent, credible)
  • As having Integrity (including responsible, authentic)
  • Positive (including problem-solving, pragmatic)
  • Engaging (including adaptable, inclusive, holistic)
  • Daring (including courageous, innovative, game-changing)

Better Cotton is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to good practice and transparency in the management of natural, human, and financial resources.

We have a zero-tolerance approach to any attitudes or behaviours that put children or adults at risk of harm. Safeguarding incidents are acts of serious misconduct and are grounds for disciplinary action, up to and including, dismissal and referral to relevant authorities for criminal prosecution. Therefore, all offers of employment are subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks.

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.

Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.

Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.

Se você quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa éa sua chance. Nessa posição de Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software Pleno, você irá somar ao time Merchant Payments , que tem comoobjetivo simplificar e garantir que as operações financeiras sejam executadas de modo simples e confiável.

No dia a dia você vai:

  • Desenvolver aplicações backend para dar suporte aos fluxos financeiros;
  • Realizar a criação de documentações como design docs e post mortens;
  • Desenhar arquiteturas de sistemas cloud;
  • Integrar e participar na definição de soluções técnicas junto ao time, sendo capaz de criticar e solucionar os desafios complexos;
  • Conduzir a elaboração técnica e de negócio do seu time, buscando entregas de alto valor agregado, com excelência técnica;
  • Participar e ter melhoria contínua dos squads, com visão de médio-longo prazo.

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Conhecimento em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Node.js , Golang ou Kotlin);
  • Conhecimentos sólidos na utilização de aplicações cloud;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicações distribuídas com uso de event driven;
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados NoSQL, SQL e experiência com utilização de bases de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicações escaláveis;
  • Experiência com acompanhamento de observabilidade de aplicações em produção;
  • Conhecimento em Git, GitLab CI e Docker.
  • Conhecimento em AWS Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS e S3;
  • Experiência no domínio financeiro;
  • Experiência prévia em aplicações desenvolvidas em Kotlin.

Nossa Cultura e Nosso Jeito | Mais sobre o grupo OLX:

Nosso propósito é "Empoderar os brasileiros para realizarem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo". Fazemos isso digitalizando a jornada de compra e venda dos nossos usuários, fortalecendo o consumo consciente e transformando a forma como nos conectamos e nos relacionamos.

Para nossas oportunidades, valorizamos a autonomia e incentivamos o protagonismo. Acreditamos que você é corresponsável pela melhor escolha, em busca de uma boa experiência. Afinal, para nós uma boa experiência é a que fica!

Não fazemos distinção de cor, nacionalidade, identidade de gênero, se o profissional possui alguma deficiência ou não… o que importa é ter as habilidades necessárias para cada função e ter garra para aproveitar os desafios e para aprender todos os dias. Aqui, damos espaço para você ser quem você é, sem julgamentos e preconceitos.

Valorizamos, desenvolvemos e reconhecemos as pessoas para que cresçam e vivam o seu melhor junto com a gente, sempre com respeito, empatia e foco no feedback contínuo.

title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho - SMS
description:
Descrição

Join to apply for the Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho - SMS role at Triunfo Logística

Acompanhar e/ou implementar os programas de segurança, proteção e meio ambiente, seguindo ou produzindo os seguintes processos: PGR, CIPA, CAT, DDS etc., fiscalizando e acompanhando o uso dos EPI s, controlando a data de expiração dos equipamentos e materiais, elaborando relatórios fotográficos, além de palestras e integrações de novos funcionários.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Distribuir diariamente aos colaboradores, os EPI`s que serão usados, recolhendo aqueles danificados e separando-os, anotando na ficha pessoal de cada colaborador o que foi retirado e qual a data do trâmite, para envio de notificação ao Auxiliar Administrativo para posterior compra, cumprimento da legislação e preservação da integridade física do colaborador;
  • Fazer levantamento diário do estoque de todo o material de segurança do trabalho (entradas e saídas), anotando em planilha manual a relação dos materiais que faltam, repassando ao Administrativo, para fins de reposição de estoque;
  • Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para inspecionar a segurança nas áreas;
  • Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando freios, faróis e etc., informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilha feita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial os problemas encontrados, para manter os veículos em boas condições e garantir a segurança dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer análise de risco com base nas atividades das equipes, definindo qual será o EPI usado, o processo mais seguro para a realização da atividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para preservar a integridade física dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer a inspeção de segurança diariamente, especificando as não conformidades existentes nos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresa responsável, para preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente;
  • Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para atender à fiscalização trabalhista;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunir as CATs, analisar levantamento de acidentes, calcular horas perdidas e enviar cópias ao Gerente de Filial e à empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e das horas perdidas;
  • Notificar, através de comunicado em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido com simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente;
  • Preencher no site do INSS uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão, local, hora, agente causador, situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador e enviando através do site do INSS;
  • Coordenar a troca ou recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para a Triunfo estar preparada em caso de incêndio;
  • Promover a integração dos novos colaboradores, apresentando os riscos, ensinando os procedimentos e análises de riscos, com treinamento total, apresentação via Power Point, palestras em sala de reuniões e apresentando-os aos Supervisores;
  • Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno com informações preventivas e atualidades.
  • Fiscalizar diariamente as Unidades para assegurar que o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) está sendo cumprido, arquivando e assinando o DDS;
  • Planejar e executar ações para conformidade com requisitos de áreas específicas, como o Porto de Itaguaí, para fins de conformidade.
  • Representar a empresa na CPATP (Comissão de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalhadores Portuários), participando de reuniões ordinárias e semestrais para justificar problemas e tomar as devidas providências;
  • Planejar, coordenar, orientar tecnicamente, avaliar e realizar estudos, avaliações e inspeções das condições de trabalho quanto aos aspectos de higiene industrial, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, em áreas, equipamentos, instalações;
  • Elaborar documentação necessária para a abertura da Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho e encaminhar ao Setor de Recursos Humanos;
  • Orientar os membros da CIPA para assuntos de saúde e higiene, através de reuniões e palestras na semana de prevenção da empresa;
  • Indicar e orientar a implementação de medidas preventivas de segurança em toda área industrial, administrativa e proteção ao meio ambiente;
  • Participar de programas de auditorias de SMS, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, acompanhar atividades operacionais nas áreas contratuais, visando à segurança do profissional envolvido, patrimônio e meio ambiente;
  • Investigar acidentes e ocorrências anormais, planejando e executando Plano de Ação;
  • Elaborar planos de contingência e coordenar atividades de controle de emergências para todas as áreas contratuais, seguindo padrões técnicos e normas operacionais.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho;
  • Registro MTE.
  • Atuação anterior na função de Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho.
  • Jornada: escala 12x36 (diurno ou noturno)

description:

The role of an Engineering Manager at Canonical

As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, while at the same time staying aware of that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked.

You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution.

You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.

We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses, in this case popular open-source machine learning tools like Kubeflow, MLFlow, and Feast.

Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high-performing team.

Location: This is a Globally remote role.

What your day will look like

  • Manage a distributed team of engineers and its MLOps/Analytics portfolio
  • Organize and lead the team's processes in order to help it achieve its objectives
  • Conduct one-on-one meetings with team members
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Interact with a vibrant community
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Attend conferences to represent Canonical and its MLOps solutions
  • Mentor and grow your direct reports, helping them achieve their professional goals
  • Work from home with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • A proven track record of professional experience of software delivery
  • Professional python development experience, preferably with a track record in open source
  • A proven understanding of the machine learning space, its challenges and opportunities to improve
  • Experience designing and implementing MLOps solutions
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Additional skills that you might also bring

The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.

  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions for the cloud.
  • Experience with building machine learning models

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software (Back-End) - Sênior
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.

Missão do cargo:

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software você fará parte de um dos times de desenvolvimento e será responsável por agregar conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo ou construindo parte das soluções de nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, buscando soluções para situações do dia a dia, visando sempre o trabalho harmônico em equipe, a qualidade do código e da arquitetura em geral.


Como será o seu dia a dia no time:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas, participando e fomentando práticas de Code Review e desenvolvimento orientado a testes;
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos.
  • Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Java, Golang e NodeJS
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços
  • Trabalhar com modelo de dados hierárquico e de grafos
  • Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões altos de performance
  • Observar o desenvolvimento seguro e estar sempre por dentro de atualizações de segurança e critérios relevantes relacionados ao desenvolvimento seguro


#Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Idealizar e construir novas soluções (análise e desenvolvimento);
  • Conceber melhorias nas arquiteturas atuais e de novas soluções;
  • Suportar questões técnicas dos projetos, em suas diversas fases, propondo soluções, indagando caminhos. Sempre de forma crítica e construtiva;
  • Recomendar modificações e melhorias em processos, visando a eficiência das áreas;
  • Solucionar/encaminhar ou ainda escalar impedimentos técnicos apontados pelo time;
  • Contribuir com o crescimento técnico do time, efetuando treinamentos, aconselhamentos (mentoria) e supervisão de pessoas desenvolvedoras menos experientes, sempre que necessário;
  • Contribuir para a produção de padrões e documentação de melhores práticas para a sua equipe e garantir que o desenvolvimento atenda a esses padrões;
  • Apoiar em práticas de desenvolvimento ágil.


#Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Compreensão de arquiteturas para processamento de grandes volumes de dados (repositórios, filas, microsserviços, etc);
  • Domínio de conceitos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software (da concepção à entrega, sustentação e operação, desenvolvimento orientado a testes, escrita e documentação de códigos, code review, etc);
  • Conhecimento intermediário ou avançado em linguagem para back-end;
  • Linguagens de programação (Go, NodeJS, SQL);
  • Banco de dados relacionais, não relacionais, colunares/AVRO e elásticos (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc);
  • Estrutura Cloud (GCP);
  • Pró-eficiência no desenvolvimento de: API Rest; Programação concorrente e escalável;
  • Conhecimento nos processos de versionamento e práticas CI/CD;
  • Experiência com práticas de Code Review e Feedback;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento orientado a testes;
  • Apresentar boa comunicação, pois somos um time bastante pró ativo e com necessidade de articulação de ideias;
  • Encarar as mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com seus erros;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento;
  • Promover nossa cultura e valores;
  • Saber como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutar do trabalho em equipe.


Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Conhecimento dos conceitos de Big Data, Data Lake, Metadados com as perspectiva das boas práticas e requisitos de governança de dados;
  • Teoria e prática em qualidade de dados (Dimensões, Profiling, Data Quality Assessment);
  • Conhecimento avançado em Go;
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura (Terraform, Ansible);
  • Conhecimento em schedulers (Crontab, Jenkins, Airflow, etc);
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de containers (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Conhecimento em serviços de mensageria (SNS, Kafka).
  • Conhecimento de BigQuery, ElasticSearch

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

O objetivo é fortalecer a performance, aumentar o engajamento e fomentar um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e de alto desempenho;

Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:

title: Venture Analyst
description:

Flow Capital Corp. is a publicly listed provider of flexible growth and alternative capital solutions dedicated to supporting market-leading, high-growth companies. Since 2018, we’ve helped businesses in the US, UK, and Canada access financing that drives growth while minimizing dilution and retaining founder control. Our focus is on revenue-generating, VC-backed, and founder-owned companies seeking growth capital. Learn more at

We’re looking for an entry-level analyst to join our venture team at Flow Capital. This role sits between our Marketing and Originations teams, starting with a focus on marketing. You’ll support a wide range of activities, including identifying and researching potential investment opportunities and supporting business development, while also contributing to marketing campaigns, content creation, and brand initiatives.

This is an excellent entry point for someone interested in gaining exposure to the venture ecosystem.

  • Track and analyze performance, providing insights to improve engagement and conversion rates.
  • Participate in events, webinars, and other initiatives to build Flow Capital’s brand.

Qualifications

  • Business or a related field degree from a strong academic program.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Familiarity with tools including AI tools, Webflow, HubSpot, Canva, outreach tools (e.g., Reply.io), PitchBook, SEMrush, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and Google Analytics.



Why Join Flow Capital?

Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem de dados, data warehouse e arquiteturas lake/lakehouse.

Familiaridade com práticas de DevOps (Git, pipelines CI/CD, Terraform ou similares).

Experiência com streaming em tempo real (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Kinesis).

Conhecimentos em containerização (Docker, Kubernetes).

Vivência com pipelines de machine learning e MLOps.

Experiência com catálogos de dados, metadata management e ferramentas de governança.

Perfil analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas.

Capacidade de comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara a públicos não técnicos.

  • Conciliação Contábil: Conciliação contábil das contas de ISS, IRRF, CSRF e INSS. Participação em projetos que envolvam a área fiscal.
  • Tributos Estaduais: Execução da rotina fiscal na apuração de ICMS e IPI de diversos estados. Conferência dos livros fiscais de entradas e saídas, Livro Apuração e CIAP. Cálculo de Diferencial de alíquota, ICMS antecipado, ICMS-ST e FECP. Validação das regras fiscais das operações, como CFOP, CST, base e alíquota destes impostos.
  • Obrigações Acessórias – Tributos Estaduais: Elaboração, validação e envio de obrigações acessórias como Sped Fiscal (EFD ICMS/IPI), GIA, GIA-ST, DAPI, DECLAN, DIME e demais obrigações conforme legislação de cada Estado. Preparação das guias de recolhimento para o fluxo de pagamento.
  • Suporte Fiscal – Tributos Estaduais: Apoio às empresas do grupo nas questões fiscais do dia a dia e setup de sistema que impacta as operações de entradas e saídas.
  • Legislação e Auditoria: Acompanhamento da legislação, suporte às áreas de negócios no esclarecimento de dúvidas fiscais e monitoramento das caixas postais estaduais. Atendimento à Auditoria externa e interna, apoio no atendimento à fiscalização e participação em projetos que envolvem a área fiscal.
  • Conciliação Contábil – Tributos Estaduais: Conciliação contábil das contas de ICMS e IPI.

  • Experiência em rotinas fiscais.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full-Stack Software Engineer (Agents & Rapid Prototyping)

Location: Remote (US-friendly hours) - Central Time Zone

Type: Full-time (founding/early engineer)

Team: Small, passionate, ego-free builders


Why this role

We’re hunting for product–market fit . That means we ship POCs fast, test hypotheses daily, and aren’t afraid to throw work away if the data says so. If you code for fun , ask “why ” before “how ,” and love turning messy problems into scrappy automation that actually saves people time—this is your playground.


So we're on the same page, Vibe-Coding is helpful to very quickly discuss feature requirements and expectations before we commit to a full build.


What you’ll do

  • Prototype at lightning speed: Build and ship POCs, internal tools, and production features in days—not weeks.
  • Work with LLMs & SLMs: Integrate, evaluate, and fine-tune models; design agentic workflows that reduce manual work.
  • Automate the boring stuff: Sniff out bottlenecks, redundancies, and paper cuts; replace them with lightweight automations.
  • Balance build vs. buy: Pragmatically choose off-the-shelf services vs. custom code; optimize for speed, cost, and learning.
  • Own the stack end-to-end: APIs, data models, frontends, deployments, instrumentation, and on-call for what you build.
  • Collaborate without ego: Pair with design, product, and GTM to clarify the “why,” define thin slices, and ship continuously.
  • Ruthlessly iterate: Be comfortable restarting weekly if needed; measure outcomes, not lines of code.


Outcomes (how we’ll measure success)

  • 2–3 prod-quality launches/month from idea → shipped.
  • Clear learning loops : each release produces measurable signal (conversion, retention, time-saved).
  • Automation ROI: hours saved/team/week; decreased cycle time; reduced ops tickets.
  • Agent impact: at least one agent in steady use by internal or pilot users within first 60 days.


You might be a fit if you

  • Have 4+ years building full-stack products (or equivalent portfolio/hacker track record).
  • Are fluent in a modern web stack (e.g., TypeScript/Node , Python , React/Next ; Postgres/Redis; REST/GraphQL).
  • Have shipped LLM/SLM features (tool use, RAG, function calling, evals, latency/cost tuning).
  • Can design simple, resilient backends; write clean, testable code; and deploy via CI/CD to a major cloud.
  • Love debugging with data : logs, traces, metrics; you instrument before you guess.
  • Communicate crisply, ask sharp questions, and default to action.
  • Thrive in ambiguity; you don’t need a JIRA novella to start building.


Nice to have

  • Vector DBs, embeddings, prompt/version management, offline evals.
  • Agent frameworks (e.g., OpenAI tools, LangGraph, custom planners/executors).
  • Queueing/event systems (e.g., Kafka, SQS), WebSockets, streaming.
  • Security and privacy basics (authn/z, secrets, PII handling).
  • Experience with low-cost scrappy stacks (Cloudflare, Fly.io, Supabase, Firebase).


Our stack (evolving)

  • FE: React/Next.js, Tailwind, tRPC/GraphQL
  • BE: Node/TypeScript and/or Python FastAPI
  • Data: Postgres, Redis/Upstash, optional vector store
  • Infra: Vercel/Fly.io/Cloudflare + Docker; CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
  • AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, local SLMs when useful; evaluation harness + prompt/version control


How we work

  • Learn > Perfect: Ship thin slices, get signal, iterate.
  • Write it down: Short RFCs → prototype → user feedback within days.
  • Builder culture: No rockstars, no heroes—just ownership and curiosity.
  • Time-zone friendly: Async first; quick huddles when needed.


Interview flow

  • Intro chat (30 min): goals, mindset, what great looks like.
  • Builder exercise (home or live, 2–4 hrs): ship a tiny agent or automation; explain trade-offs.
  • Technical deep dive (60 min): architecture, data modeling, reliability, AI evals/cost.
  • Team fit (30 min): collaboration, feedback loops, “why before what.”


Compensation

Competitive salary + meaningful equity. We optimize for ownership and impact .

title: SAP Release Manager
description:
Role: SAP Release Manager

Location: LATAM Region (Remote)

Duration: 06+ Months Contract


An SAP Release Manager plans, coordinates, and controls the entire SAP release lifecycle, from defining release strategies and schedules to managing deployments and post-go-live support, ensuring quality, minimizing business disruption, and maintaining compliance with standards like ITIL and SOX. Key responsibilities include stakeholder communication, risk management, process governance, and continuous improvement of the release process through post-release reviews and key performance indicator (KPI) tracking.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategy & Planning: Develop and maintain the SAP release strategy, plan, and calendar, coordinating release windows and cycles across various SAP modules and integrated applications.
  • Execution & Coordination: Manage and coordinate all release activities, ensuring timely and seamless execution by working closely with development, testing, and infrastructure teams.
  • Governance & Compliance: Implement and enforce release management processes and quality gates, ensuring adherence to standards such as ITIL, SOX, and audit requirements.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks to the release schedule, quality, and scope, and develop mitigation strategies to prevent delays or disruptions.
  • Stakeholder Management: Liaise with business stakeholders, project managers, and other relevant teams to align release activities with business priorities.
  • Communication: Act as the central point of communication, providing transparency on release plans, risks, impacts, and progress to all involved parties.
  • Post-Release Activities: Conduct post-release reviews and postmortems, track release KPIs (success rate, defect leakage), and identify lessons learned for continuous process improvement.
  • Quality Assurance: Oversee the entire release lifecycle, ensuring that all release criteria, including functionality, performance, and security requirements, are met before deployment.
  • Process Improvement: Drive initiatives to improve workflows and efficiency, developing and implementing automation tools and frameworks to streamline release processes.

title: Data Engineer_ Snowflake
description:
Job Description: Senior Snowflake Data Engineer (Migration & Modelling)

Location: Brazil/ Costa Rica (Remote)

Job Type: Contract / Project-Based (Staff Augmentation)

Note : Need to support PST timings


Project Summary:

We are seeking highly skilled Snowflake Data Engineers to act as augmented members of a client's data team. You will be responsible for the hands-on execution of a complex, end-to-end data platform migration to Snowflake.

This is a hands-on execution role. You will be expected to integrate seamlessly with the existing team and take direct ownership of critical migration and data modelling tasks to accelerate the project's delivery. This is a complex transformation, not a simple "lift-and-shift."


Key Responsibilities:

  • Data Modelling & Architecture:
  • Collaborate with the client's BI and Data Science teams to define data requirements.
  • Design, develop, and implement conceptual, logical, and physical data models (e.g., Dimensional, Star Schema) optimized for Snowflake.
  • Develop and document data models, data definitions, and data flow diagrams for the new environment.
  • Data Migration & Engineering:
  • Execute the hands-on technical migration of data from legacy systems to the Snowflake Data Cloud
  • Engineer, build, and optimize robust ELT/ETL data pipelines within Snowflake (using SnowSQL, Snowpipe, Streams, Tasks, etc.).
  • Implement and automate data quality checks and validation processes to ensure data integrity and accuracy.
  • Team Integration & Delivery:
  • Integrate directly with the client's data team, participating in all relevant project routines and workflows.
  • Take ownership of assigned migration and modeling tasks, delivering high-quality, production-ready code and models with minimal supervision.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to data migration, modeling, and pipeline performance.
  • Create clear technical documentation for all developed assets (models, pipelines, etc.).


Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Expert-level Snowflake: Deep, proven, hands-on experience with the Snowflake platform (architecture, SnowSQL, Snowpipe, performance optimization).
  • Expert-level Data Modeling: 4+ years of dedicated experience in data modeling (Dimensional, Relational) and data warehousing architecture.
  • Proven Data Migration: 4+ years of experience executing complex, large-scale data warehouse migrations (non-lift-and-shift).
  • Strong Data Engineering: Proficiency in building data pipelines (ELT/ETL) using SQL and modern tools (e.g., dbt, Python, or similar).
  • Execution Focus: A proven "do-er" with the ability to integrate into an existing team and deliver on complex technical tasks independently.
  • BI / Analytics Acumen: Strong understanding of how data models are consumed by BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.) and Data Science workloads.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Context

We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past months, achieving 8x revenue growth in the last 18 months and a 10x usage increase over the same period. As we continue this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to ensure our products remain reliable, intuitive, and delightful for our ever-growing user base.


Mission

As a DevOps/Infrastructure team member, your primary mission will be to help ensuring that our infrastructure is scalable, reliable, and cost-effective, supporting the company’s rapid growth and evolving needs. You will play a critical role in both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic planning, helping shape our platform's future.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Infrastructure Scaling and Stability : Contribute to the continuous scaling of our infrastructure to handle increasing loads while maintaining stability and performance. This includes designing and implementing robust and scalable architectures, automating deployment processes, and optimizing resource allocation.
  • Performance Optimization : You will continuously monitor and analyze system performance, identifying bottlenecks and areas for improvement. You will also work on optimizing our infrastructure and applications to ensure low-latency, high-throughput operation, particularly for video and audio processing.
  • Cost Management : Implement strategies to optimize infrastructure costs without compromising performance. This includes rightsizing resources, automating scaling policies, and leveraging cloud provider cost-saving mechanisms.
  • Enhancing Observability : Improve our monitoring and observability capabilities, ensuring we have comprehensive visibility into the health and performance of our infrastructure. You will develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, and logs that provide actionable insights for the entire engineering team.
  • Collaboration and Support : Work closely with developers and other stakeholders to ensure seamless integration between infrastructure and applications. Provide guidance and support on infrastructure-related topics, fostering a culture of shared responsibility for the system’s reliability.
  • Security and Compliance : Contribute to the security and compliance of our infrastructure by implementing best practices and staying up-to-date with industry standards.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement : Stay abreast of industry trends and technologies and proactively suggest and implement improvements. You will have the opportunity to experiment with new tools and methodologies, driving innovation within the team.
Who We Are Looking For

We seek a highly skilled and experienced DevOps/Infrastructure Engineer who is passionate about building and maintaining scalable, reliable, and efficient infrastructure. You should have a strong background in managing complex environments across cloud providers and bare-metal servers and be comfortable working in high-performance environments, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues before they impact the system.


Key Qualifications:
  • Kubernetes  Mastery : Proven experience designing, deploying, and managing Kubernetes clusters in production environments.
  • Multi-Cloud and Bare Metal Expertise : Deep understanding of at least one primary cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and experience managing infrastructure on bare-metal servers. You should be familiar with each environment’s unique challenges and opportunities and capable of leveraging their strengths effectively.
  • Infrastructure at Scale: Demonstrated ability to architect and manage infrastructure that can scale horizontally and vertically, supporting a growing user base and increasing traffic. Experience with distributed systems, load balancing, and automated scaling strategies is essential.
  • Cost Optimization & Resource Management : Strong focus on optimizing infrastructure to balance performance and cost. You should be proficient in tools and techniques for monitoring resource usage, identifying inefficiencies, and implementing cost-saving measures.
  • Programming and Automation : Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g.Bash, Python).
  • Monitoring and Observability : You should have a deep understanding of best practices for monitoring, logging, and observability. Experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar systems is crucial. You should also be able to design systems that provide comprehensive insights into infrastructure health and performance.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset : You should thrive on solving complex problems and constantly look for ways to improve system reliability, performance, and efficiency. Strong analytical skills and a methodical approach to troubleshooting are essential.
  • Collaboration and Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. You should be comfortable collaborating across teams to ensure that infrastructure decisions support broader company goals.


Bonus Qualifications:
  • Experience with Media Processing : Familiarity with video and audio processing, streaming, or related technologies is a strong advantage. This includes understanding the performance implications and resource requirements of media workloads.
  • Familiarity with the Node.js environment and applications at scale is a strong advantage
  • Familiarity with configuration management tools like Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet is a plus

What You Will Be Doing
  • Completes onsite and remote monitoring activities in accordance with all ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, SOPs and study processes.   • Verifies proper management and accountability of Investigational Product (IP).

  • Performs key risk assessment and management responsibilities throughout the project, including key risk indicator and site health analysis, site process evaluation, and project escalation.
  • Participates in audit preparation and follow-up activities as needed.

  • Gathers and reviews information for assigned siteand identifies inconsistencies. With limitedguidance from project and functional management, assesses risk and escalatesas appropriate.
  • Assists with non-complex adhoc, short-term assignmentin support of additional studies or departmental initiatives.

  • Previous experience supporting clinical trials including solid on-site monitoring experience in CROs or pharma companies.

description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


Job Title: Audio Transcription Specialist (Language: Portuguese, Location: Portugal)


About The Role:

We are seeking detail-oriented and dedicated professionals with hands-on experience in audio transcription and quality assurance . The ideal candidate will be responsible for accurately converting audio content into written text, maintaining high standards of accuracy, consistency, and confidentiality throughout the process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Listen carefully to audio recordings and transcribe them into clear, accurate, and grammatically correct text .

  • Handle different accents, speech clarity levels, and background noises with attention to detail.
  • Tag and label transcriptions as per project guidelines.
  • Review, proofread, and edit transcripts for quality, accuracy, and completeness .
  • Follow client-specific formatting and delivery instructions.
  • Work closely with project leads and QA teams to meet daily quality and productivity targets .
  • Maintain confidentiality and data security of all content handled.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in audio transcription or related linguistic work.
  • Excellent command of English (or other project-specific language) with strong grammar and listening skills.
  • Good typing speed and accuracy with familiarity in transcription tools or software.
  • Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines .
  • High attention to detail and ability to follow formatting guidelines strictly.
  • Must have a reliable internet connection, functional laptop/desktop, and good-quality headphones (mandatory).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in AI training, transcription QA, or linguistic data projects .
  • Familiarity with timestamping, labeling, or annotation tasks .
  • Experience working with global transcription platforms or large-scale linguistic projects.
  • Knowledge of speech-to-text software and audio editing tools is an added advantage.

title: Principal Engineer – Guidance & Control (Technical Leader)
description:
Location: On-Site position based in the UAE (Full Relocation Package)


A leading defense company based in the United Arab Emirates is seeking an exceptional Principal Engineer to act as the Technical Leader for Guidance and Control (G&C) systems . This is a strategic, high-impact and hands-on role with an explicit mandate to establish and lead new G&C capabilities, mentor engineers, and drive the future of guided weapon platforms.


The Role: Technical Authority & Capability Builder


As the Principal Engineer for G&C, you will be the technical backbone of the department, reporting directly to the Department Manager. Your responsibilities include:

  • G&C Technical Leadership: Serving as the technical authority over the full G&C lifecycle, including Modeling & Simulation (MIL/SIL/PIL) , Guidance & Control Algorithms , Tracking Systems , and Estimation Filters (EKF/KF) .
  • R&D and Capability Establishment: Leading the investigation of emerging technologies and the implementation of futuristic methodologies. You will be responsible for establishing new G&C infrastructure, tools, and R&D labs .
  • Flight Test Oversight: Managing all phases of flight test campaigns, including pre-flight preparation, test execution, and rigorous post-flight analysis .
  • Mentorship and Team Building: Providing technical guidance and mentoring to engineers across all levels (Junior to Senior), helping to cultivate a high-performing team.


Requirements for Success


  • Experience: 10–15 years of experience in the development of guided weapon systems , missiles, or relevant defense technologies.
  • Leadership: A minimum of 5 years of experience in engineering management and technical leadership roles, with a proven ability to lead teams and establish new capabilities.
  • Expertise: Deep knowledge of the entire Systems Engineering Process (qualification, acceptance, flight testing) and a strong background in flight dynamics, embedded systems, and missile control .
  • Qualifications: A Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.


Ready for Your Next Career Move?


This is a Full-Time Employee (FTE) position requiring a professional who is willing to relocate to Abu Dhabi, UAE . A full relocation package is offered to ensure a smooth transition.


This role offers a clear career path toward Senior Principal Engineer and Chief Engineer , allowing you to directly shape the technological future of defense in the region.

If you are a result-driven technical leader ready to build and innovate in a high-stakes environment, we want to hear from you.


Apply now and help us establish next-generation guidance and control capabilities!

description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) Sênior para fortalecer a base técnica que sustenta nossa plataforma de dados financeiros.
