Garantir a segurança e conformidade da infraestrutura, incluindo controle de acesso, rede e comunicação entre serviços com Istio

Experiência com AWS e serviços como EKS, RDS, IAM, S3, entre outros

Conhecimento sólido em redes, protocolos de comunicação, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, TLS e roteamento

Forte conhecimento em Kubernetes e ferramentas de gerenciamento de infraestrutura

Experiência com ArgoCD e GitOps

Conhecimento avançado em observabilidade e tracing distribuído

Experiência com Istio ou outra solução de Service Mesh

Experiência com automação e infraestrutura como código (Crossplane, Kustomization, Terraform, etc.)

Conhecimento em CI/CD com GitHub Actions ou similares

Experiência em troubleshooting e otimização de PostgreSQL em produção

Conhecimento em scripting (Bash, Python ou Go) para automação

Experiência com práticas de FinOps


Diferenciais:

Experiência com security hardening em ambientes Kubernetes

Experiência com Open Policy Agent ou similares

Experiência com banco de dados PostgreSQL, garantindo alta disponibilidade e otimização de desempenho

Experiência em gerenciamento de Operadores de Bancos de Dados no Kubernetes como CloudNativePG e Zalando

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Technical Support Engineer (Infra/Deploy)
description:
About the Project

Our client is a Business Intelligence platform enabling customers to connect multiple data sources (e.g., Excel, SQL) into a unified environment, build interactive dashboards, apply formulas, and customize via plugins, scripts, and embedding. The product supports both SaaS and on-prem deployments. Support is organized into 4 pods: Analytics, DevEx, Data, and Infra.


About Role:

As a Technical Solutions Engineer, you will work with leading enterprise organizations and startups to realize the power of data analytics. Our Technical Solutions team spans the globe and uses the SWARM model for our tools, processes, and organizational structure. This shift focuses on driving a collaborative, rewarding environment that measures value creation and team playing.

Our team is aligned directly with our Product and Engineering teams through a robust Subject Matter Expert program. We are employing best-in-breed tools along with processes co-authored or directly influenced by our team. We believe in the power of great customer experience, and the happiest customers are made by having the happiest team helping them.


Work Hours : PST business hours.


Required skills:

  • Proven hands-on experience supporting a software platform/product in a customer-facing B2B environment.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts in a clear, concise, and professional manner.
  • Hands-on experience with Linux operating systems (Debian and RHEL-based), including package management, service management, log analysis, file permissions, user and process management, and troubleshooting system resources (CPU, memory, disk, I/O).
  • Basic networking knowledge, including OSI,DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, subnets, routing, and firewall concepts, with ability to troubleshoot using tools like ping, traceroute, curl, or netstat.
  • Understanding of containerisation (images, containers, networking, volumes) and virtualisation (VMs, hypervisors) concepts, and familiarity with orchestration concepts such as deployments, scaling, and service discovery.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes is a strong advantage.


Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of Python or scripting languages such as Bash is a plus.
  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs is an advantage.
  • Experience with cloud providers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) is an advantage.


About you:

  • You have a data-driven, analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving skills
  • You are detail-oriented, with the ability to prioritize, multitask, and meet deadlines
  • You demonstrate a proven ability to stay motivated and work effectively both independently and as part of a team
  • You bring a proactive passion for supporting and helping others
  • You have a strong desire to learn, grow, and contribute to the company’s core values of collaboration and service
  • You possess excellent English communication, listening, and writing skills
  • You possess a strong sense towards customer sentiment and adapt your communication style accordingly

Scope of work:

  • You will handle customer questions and issues by combining business acumen with technical assessment skills. You will perform troubleshooting of issues both through the UI and the terminal
  • You will work closely with Senior team members to develop your skills and technical expertise within specific areas of the product, with ongoing opportunities to grow

Highlight Job of the Week!

Pay Rate LinkedIn style:

Full-Time Monthly Rates: $2,000 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. Job Summary: The Sales Assistant will be responsible for generating leads, nurturing prospects, and closing sales for the U.S.-based companies. title: Full Stack Software Engineer (LAMP)
description:
We are looking for a full-time remote Full-Stack Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience producing commercial-grade software that is highly maintainable and supportable. The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience and strong problem-solving abilities, quickly learn new technologies and concepts, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent. The client provides industry-leading software for environmental compliance, fuel management, and facility maintenance in the retail and commercial fuel industry. Their platform helps major fuel networks, including global brands, monitor and optimize their operations by delivering real-time insights, automating compliance tasks, and ensuring site uptime.

As a software engineer on this team, you'll have the opportunity to work on scalable cloud-based solutions that make a measurable impact on sustainability and operational efficiency in a mission-critical industry. More specifically, you will work to modernize an application that enables quick deployments into international cloud regions to support markets with data residency restrictions, provide updates, and strengthen its security posture.


Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and enhance an existing LAMP-based web application to ensure continued stability and performance
  • Design and develop modern application components, including both front-end features and back-end services
  • Take technical ownership of features, contributing to both functional and technical specifications to align with business goals
  • Independently deliver high-quality product features and updates, while proactively seeking guidance when needed to maintain momentum
  • Write and execute unit tests to ensure code quality and reliability
  • Investigate and resolve defects identified during QA and user acceptance testing cycles
  • Actively participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to discuss priorities, progress, and share ideas or technical insights
  • Apply a solid understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) to projects of increasing complexity, with a focus on:
  • Problem solving
  • Critical thinking
  • System analysis and design
  • Effort estimation
  • Sprint and release planning

Required Experience:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • 4+ years of full-stack development experience using PHP, Linux (AWS EC2), Apache, and MySQL to build and maintain production-grade, commercial web applications
  • Hands-on experience with AWS CloudFormation (infrastructure as code) and deploying containerized applications using AWS ECS (Docker)
  • Solid understanding of Agile development practices, object-oriented programming, and multi-tiered software architectures
  • Proven ability to work independently while recognizing when to collaborate or seek guidance to meet deadlines and maintain high quality
  • Strong team player with a collaborative mindset and practical communication skills
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technologies and concepts
  • Adaptable and open to change, with a proactive attitude and passion for continuous improvement
  • Self-motivated, results-driven, creative, and accountable in delivering work to a high standard


Preferred Experience:

  • University degree or equivalent education (a technical or engineering degree is optimal)
  • Familiarity with AWS networking concepts, including VPC design and VPN configuration.
  • Experience working with AWS SQS for decoupled, event-driven architectures and AWS S3 for object storage and data lifecycle management.


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Mathematics/Statics Subject Matter Expert (Master/PHD)
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.


About the Role:


At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.


We are seeking a Mathematics Subject Matter Expert with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.


Key Responsibilities:


Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing


Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:

title: Senior Backend (Node+Python) Engineer
description:

Requirements

- 5+ years of professional experience in backend engineering with Node.js and Python.

- Strong expertise with PostgreSQL (schema design, indexing, query optimization, performance tuning).

- Experience building RESTful APIs and backend services in production environments.

- Hands-on experience with FastAPI and Pydantic , or equivalent Python frameworks.

- Experience deploying and managing applications on Google Cloud Platform.

- Familiarity with Firebase services (authentication, cloud messaging, or data synchronization).


Nice to have

- Experience working with microservices or event-driven architectures.

- Knowledge of messaging systems (Kafka, Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ).

- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or CI/CD pipelines.

- Familiarity with observability tools and monitoring best practices.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Já foram identificados mais de  R$ 2 bilhões em oportunidades de aumento de lucro para +350 clientes no país.


Formamos parcerias com essas equipes que, com o uso de nossas ferramentas, entregam mais resultados para seus gestores como redução de glosas/bloqueios, aumento da rentabilidade de medicamentos e materiais médicos, tanto via redução de custos quanto aumento de receita e revisão de mix, e automatização de processos de controle da cadeia de fornecedores e fiscais. Além disso, otimizamos processos internos via tecnologia para liberar tempo da equipe para dedicar atenção e esforços ao que realmente gera valor.


Tudo que desenvolvemos foi com base no feedback das dores destas equipes em diversos hospitais Brasil afora. Conhecemos profundamente as necessidades do setor e sabemos como ajudar.

A Verzo é celebrada por sua excelência em inovação e qualidade de serviço. Contrato PJ

  • Capacidade de lidar com diferentes perfis de clientes e influenciadores de decisão (C-level, gestores e técnicos).

O que valorizamos:

Pautada pelos valores de família e conduzida por uma família, a marca tem expertise na criação, desenvolvimento e produção de mobiliário com alto valor agregado, que passa por uma curadoria afiada de uma equipe multidisciplinar preparada para atender as mais diversas demandas de um mercado exigente e que se moderniza a todo momento.

A Breton assume sua responsabilidade com a sustentabilidade e está comprometida em adotar práticas em todas as etapas de sua cadeia produtiva, buscando um melhor aproveitamento dos recursos naturais. Saiba mais em ou @bretonoficial.

Com design, sofisticação e cuidado em cada detalhe, buscamos transformar a experiência dos nossos clientes, oferecendo móveis que unem beleza, conforto e exclusividade.

No nosso Outlet do Rio de Janeiro , oferecemos peças especiais do nosso portfólio com condições diferenciadas — e buscamos alguém que, assim como nós, tenha brilho nos olhos para encantar clientes e transformar atendimentos em experiências memoráveis.

  • Receber e atender clientes na loja, apresentando as peças disponíveis no showroom e no estoque.

  • Realizar vendas e registrar pedidos no sistema, acompanhando todo o processo até a entrega.
  • Manter a organização do espaço de loja e auxiliar no controle do estoque.
  • Contribuir para que a experiência Breton seja percebida em cada detalhe, do primeiro contato ao pós-venda.

  • Proatividade, organização e foco em resultados.

Diferenciais que contam pontos:

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

The DevOps engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization.   • Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
  • Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
  • Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.

  • Experience in a DevOps role, with hands-on AWS experience;
  • Experience with IaC tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;

  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools like CircleCI and GithubActions;

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, Zero Trust, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;

title: GIS Python Developer
description:
GIS Python Developer (QA/QC Automation – ArcGIS Workflow Manager)

Location: 100% Remote

Type: Full-Time / Contract

About the Role

We are looking for a GIS Python Developer to design, develop, and implement automated Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) processes for spatial data. The role involves writing Python scripts (primarily using ArcPy or the ArcGIS API for Python ) and integrating them into Esri’s ArcGIS Workflow Manager to streamline and automate GIS data validation across teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop QA/QC Scripts:
  • Create and maintain Python scripts to automatically identify and correct spatial data issues such as:
  • Missing or invalid geometry
  • Polygon overlaps or gaps
  • Attribute inconsistencies
  • Coordinate system mismatches
  • Topology and connectivity errors (e.g., roads not connecting properly)


  • Integrate with ArcGIS Workflow Manager:
  • Configure and embed QA/QC scripts as automated steps within ArcGIS Workflow Manager task sequences, enabling:
  • Automatic validation after data edits or updates
  • Flagging and reporting of errors for correction
  • Consistent enforcement of spatial data quality standards


  • Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance:
  • Maintain accuracy, consistency, and traceability of all GIS data edits and updates across the enterprise environment.


  • Collaborate Across Teams:
  • Work closely with GIS analysts, database administrators, and developers to ensure smooth integration, performance optimization, and scalability of QA/QC solutions.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Computer Science, Geomatics , or a related field.
  • Proven experience in Python scripting for GIS automation .
  • Strong knowledge of Esri technologies , including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise , and ArcGIS Workflow Manager .
  • Experience with ArcPy and/or the ArcGIS API for Python .
  • Understanding of spatial data models, topology rules, and coordinate systems .
  • Familiarity with data quality management principles (QA/QC) in GIS environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with versioned geodatabases (ArcSDE) and enterprise data workflows.
  • Exposure to SQL and spatial database management.
  • Knowledge of automation frameworks or DevOps practices within GIS.


What You’ll Achieve

You’ll play a key role in building a repeatable, automated, and auditable quality-control process for spatial data—ensuring every dataset and map product meets enterprise accuracy standards before publication or approval.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join the Prosigliere team.


Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Engineer to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in designing, building, and maintaining robust and scalable data pipelines and infrastructure. This role requires a deep understanding of data warehousing principles, ETL processes, and database management, with a strong focus on ensuring data quality, accessibility, and performance to support our analytical and reporting needs. You will play a critical role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, empowering our data-driven decision-making across the organization.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and efficient ETL/ELT pipelines using various data integration techniques to ingest, transform, and load data from diverse sources into our data warehouse.
  • Manage and optimize data models and structures within Snowflake, ensuring strategic organization for performance, cost-efficiency, and ease of consumption by analytics and reporting tools.
  • Administer and optimize PostgreSQL databases, including schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Develop, monitor, and troubleshoot data workflows and orchestrations using Apache Airflow to ensure timely and reliable data delivery.
  • Collaborate closely with data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy, and consistency by implementing robust data validation, cleansing, and monitoring processes.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize existing Tableau reports, and develop new, insightful dashboards and visualizations to meet business needs.
  • Implement and maintain data governance best practices, including data security, privacy, and compliance.
  • Participate in code reviews, contribute to architectural discussions, and promote best practices in data engineering.
  • Continuously evaluate and recommend new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform and processes.


Technology Requirements

  • Databases: Strong expertise in PostgreSQL and extensive experience with Snowflake data warehousing.
  • Orchestration: Proficient in using Apache Airflow for workflow management and scheduling.
  • ETL/ELT: Proven experience in designing and implementing efficient ETL/ELT processes.
  • Business Intelligence: Hands-on experience with Tableau for report troubleshooting and development.
  • Programming Languages: Strong proficiency in Python for data manipulation, scripting, and automation.
  • Cloud Platforms: Experience with at least one major cloud provider (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and their data-related services (e.g., S3, EC2, Azure Data Lake Storage, Google Cloud Storage, BigQuery).
  • Data Concepts: Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, data lakes, and data marts.
  • Version Control: Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • SQL: Advanced SQL writing and optimization skills.
  • Big Data Technologies (Plus): Familiarity with big data technologies like Spark, Kafka, or similar is a plus.


Profile Requirements

  • Ability to learn quickly and work independently.
  • Strong project management and interpersonal skills.
  • A team player who enjoys collaborating with others.

title: Chatbot Developer Pleno
description:
Unidade de Negócio: Gringo & Zapay


Objetivos do cargo que você irá atuar: Responsável por desenvolver e manter chatbots em diferentes plataformas, com foco em JavaScript e Python.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Manutenção Multi-Plataforma: Atuar na sustentação, troubleshooting e correção de bugs de chatbots desenvolvidos e implantados nas plataformas BLiP e Rasa.
  • Evolução Rasa: Manter e evoluir a estrutura do framework Rasa, incluindo as custom actions, o deploy e, principalmente, os pipelines de NLU e as stories complexas.
  • Gestão de Infraestrutura Rasa: Gerenciar e manter o ambiente de deploy do bot em Rasa, garantindo o bom funcionamento e a estabilidade.
  • Integrações: Utilizar integrações de back-end (APIs, Webhooks) para o funcionamento dos fluxos em ambas as plataformas.
  • Qualidade Conversacional e Métricas: Trabalhar com a curadoria, refinando modelos de NLP/NLU. Além disso, definir e monitorar métricas de performance conversacional (ex: Intent Accuracy, Fallback Rate, Tempo de Resposta), propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Código e Padrões: Escrever e manter código limpo, testável e bem documentado, especialmente nas custom actions do Rasa (Python) e nos scripts do BLiP (JavaScript/Node.js).
  • Versionamento e CI/CD: Garantir o controle de versão com Git e auxiliar na manutenção de pipelines de CI/CD para automação do deploy do bot.
  • Documentação: Manter a documentação técnica da arquitetura, integrações e procedimentos de manutenção.


Requisitos e qualificações


É imprescindível que você tenha:


  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e, principalmente, na sustentação (manutenção) de chatbots nas plataformas BLiP e Rasa.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Python e JavaScript/Node.js.
  • Domínio na utilização (consumo) de APIs REST/RESTful e Webhooks.
  • Conhecimento em NLP/NLU (treinamento, curadoria e fine-tuning de Intents e Entities).
  • Experiência com Git e familiaridade com conceitos de CI/CD.
  • Conhecimento e experiência prática com Docker.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (SQL).
  • Resolução de Problemas (Troubleshooting): Capacidade analítica para identificar, diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos complexos em produção de forma eficaz.
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Vivência em Scrum e/ou Kanban.


Não obrigatório, mas será incrível se você tiver:

  • Experiência com curadoria de dados conversacionais e otimização do dataset de treinamento.
  • Domínio na criação de APIs REST/RESTful do zero.
  • Conhecimento e experiência com bancos de dados NoSQL (ex: MongoDB, Redis) para armazenamento de contexto e dados conversacionais.
  • Familiaridade com orquestração de containers (ex: Kubernetes) para deploy de Rasa em escala.
  • Conhecimento em prompt engineering e integração de Modelos de Linguagem (LLMs) em fluxos de chatbot.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) para hospedagem de serviços de apoio.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Judi is a U.S.-based healthcare technology company that provides pharmacy benefit management (PBM) services. Their focus is on making prescription drug pricing more transparent and affordable for employers, health plans, and patients.

Join our mission to transform our nation’s healthcare system as a Senior Full-stack Software Developer. In this role, you will assist in leading projects from design to delivery. Partner with product managers and designers to define requirements during discovery and planning. Collaborate with developers to deliver those requirements on time as new features or improvements to existing functionality.


Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • We have a remote-first culture.
  • You will make a tangible impact on society. Your code will directly improve healthcare experiences for millions.
  • We are a late-stage startup with stability. We have startup energy with a focus on delivery, but healthy processes with a strong financial outlook that provides a sense of security.


Position Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll combine technical leadership with hands-on coding to build scalable, high-impact healthcare technology. You will:

  • Exercise leadership over features from design to delivery.
  • Be a partner to product, design, and quality assurance team members.
  • Become a subject matter expert on your team’s products.
  • Provide technical support to cross-functional team members and stakeholders.
  • Expand Judi, our web-based enterprise health platform, using Python, AWS services, React/Typescript, and other technologies.
  • Work in an Agile/Scrum environment.


Preferred Qualifications

We’re looking for someone who brings a mix of technical expertise, problem-solving ability, and collaborative spirit:

  • 7+ years of job-related experience.
  • Desire to work at a health tech company.
  • Strong Python (Flask / SQLAlchemy) and React / Typescript experience.
  • Advanced PostgreSQL database knowledge (e.g., common table expressions, windowing functions, views, stored procedures, full-text or geospatial indexing).
  • Experience with infrastructure as code using AWS, Terraform, or similar technologies.
  • Experience writing unit and integration tests.
  • Git expertise and experience working in a mono repo.
  • Able to demonstrate agency, urgency, and ownership over delivering quality work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Previous Pharmacy Benefits Manager (PBM) experience is a plus.


What You Get:

  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team;
  • Unlimited PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule;
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences;
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work.


This position description is designed to be flexible, allowing management the opportunity to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities as needed to best meet organizational goals.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
DevOps Engineer


Are you looking to join a highly regarded IT development firm?


Look no further! WebCreek is hiring a DevOps Engineer with 3+ years of experience and a high level of English to work remotely from Latin America.


This role focuses on ensuring reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure through automation, continuous integration, and deployment best practices. You’ll take the lead on optimizing cloud environments, improving CI/CD pipelines, and implementing monitoring and security strategies to support high-performance software delivery. In this fast-paced environment, your expertise will be key to driving efficiency, reliability, and continuous improvement across all development and operations processes.


What You'll Do

  • Manage and optimize Kubernetes clusters and containerized environments.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.
  • Deploy and manage infrastructure in Microsoft Azure using Terraform (IaC).
  • Automate processes with PowerShell, Bash, or similar scripting tools.
  • Ensure smooth integration between on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve system performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with development and operations teams to enhance delivery pipelines.
  • Apply security and compliance best practices across systems and workflows.


What You Have

Required Skills:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps or Cloud Infrastructure roles.
  • Experience working with Kubernetes and container orchestration in production environments.
  • Strong background in CI/CD automation using GitHub and GitHub Actions.
  • Proven experience with Microsoft Azure, including integration with on-premises infrastructure (hybrid environments).
  • Solid scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, or equivalent languages.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles.
  • A strong automation mindset, focused on simplifying workflows and reducing manual processes.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading projects and mentoring teams.
  • Advanced knowledge of Kubernetes deployment strategies.
  • Experience with Redis, Elasticsearch, or other distributed caching/search technologies.
  • Familiarity with messaging systems (RabbitMQ, Kafka, etc.).
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible.


What You'll Gain

  • A full-time position with long-term growth opportunities.
  • Competitive salary with regular performance-based reviews.
  • Access to top-tier benefits and professional development programs.
  • In-house IT training and industry-recognized certifications.
  • Flexible, remote-friendly work environment.
  • Health care expense sponsorship to support your well-being.
  • Fitness sponsorship to help you stay active and healthy.
  • Work with top global brands and industry-leading companies.
  • A collaborative international team with opportunities to work abroad.


Who We Are

WebCreek provides world- class software development teams and technical staff augmentation to Fortune 500 companies and other global industry leaders. With over 29 years of experience and a global presence spanning 20+ offices across North America, Latin America, Asia, and Europe, we deliver top-tier digital solutions to the companies that power the world.

Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Certificada pelo 5º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Back-end Sênior com sólida experiência em Java , Node.js e Arquiteturas avançadas para integrar nosso time de tecnologia. A pessoa ideal será responsável por desenvolver e manter aplicações web robustas, escaláveis e de alta performance, assim como atuar próximo ao Tech Lead para definições técnicas para o desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades

  • Auxiliar Tech Lead em Definições Técnica: Orientar decisões arquiteturais, definir stack tecnológico e estabelecer padrões de desenvolvimento;
  • Auxiliar Desenvolvimento: Auxiliar em dúvidas tecnicas equipes, conduzir code reviews e desenvolver programadores pleno/júnior;
  • Performance e Escalabilidade: Otimizar aplicações para alta performance, implementar estratégias de cache e load balancing;
  • Segurança Corporativa: Implementar práticas de segurança, auditoria de código e compliance com padrões enterprise;
  • Integração Complexa: Desenvolver integrações críticas com sistemas legados, APIs de terceiros e serviços externos;
  • Disaster Recovery: Projetar estratégias de backup, recuperação e alta disponibilidade;
  • Inovação Técnica: Pesquisar e implementar novas tecnologias, POCs e melhorias de processo;
  • Gestão de Incidentes: Auxiliar troubleshooting de problemas críticos em produção;
  • Desenvolvimento de Microserviços: Criar e manter APIs REST utilizando Spring Boot e NestJS para sistemas de alta disponibilidade;
  • Integração de Sistemas: Implementar comunicação entre serviços via RabbitMQ, OpenFeign e APIs externas;
  • Documentação: Manter documentação técnica atualizada e especificações de APIs;
  • Testes Automatizados: Desenvolver testes unitários, integração e contratos (PACT) garantindo qualidade do código;
  • Integração de Sistemas: Implementar comunicação entre serviços via RabbitMQ, OpenFeign e APIs externas;
  • Gestão de Dados: Desenvolver soluções com MongoDB, bancos relacionais (JPA/Hibernate) e Redis para cache.


Requisitos

  • Arquitetura Avançada: Domain-Driven Design, Event Sourcing, CQRS, Hexagonal Architecture;
  • Java/Spring Ecosystem: Spring Boot 3.x, Spring Cloud Gateway, Spring Security, WebFlux;
  • Node.js (Avançado), NestJS, Express, Event Loop optimization, clustering;
  • Databases: Modelagem avançada, sharding, replicação, performance tuning;
  • Distributed Systems: Consensus algorithms, CAP theorem, eventual consistency;
  • Cloud Native: AWS/Azure/GCP, Terraform, service mesh, observability;
  • DevOps Avançado: Kubernetes operators, Helm charts, GitOps;
  • Mensageria: RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka;
  • Testes: JUnit, Jest, Mockito, TestContainers
  • Versionamento: Git, GitLab/GitHub.


Diferenciais

  • Big Data: Apache Kafka, Elasticsearch, data streaming;
  • Machine Learning: MLOps, model serving, data pipelines;
  • Blockchain/Web3: Smart contracts, DeFi protocols;
  • Edge Computing: CDN optimization, edge functions.

title: Analista de Atração e Seleção
description:
Quem somos?


A primeira unidade da AMAGGI, a Sementes Maggi, foi inaugurada em 1977 na cidade de São Miguel do Iguaçu, no Paraná. Dois anos depois, em 1979, tiveram início as atividades em Mato Grosso, com a aquisição de uma fazenda no município de Itiquira.


Desde então, a empresa tem ampliado suas unidades e áreas de negócios, expandindo a atuação no Brasil e no exterior. Com sede em Cuiabá (MT), é hoje a maior companhia brasileira na cadeia de grãos e fibras do país e está presente também na China, Argentina, Paraguai, Holanda, Noruega, Singapura e Suíça.


Além disso, desde 1997 contribui para o desenvolvimento local e humano nas comunidades onde atua, colocando-se como parceira no desenvolvimento sustentável dessas localidades por meio da Fundação André e Lucia Maggi.


Sobre a vaga


Atribuições:

  • Conduzir processos seletivos de ponta a ponta — desde a triagem de currículos até entrevistas, aplicação de testes e apoio à tomada de decisão;
  • Conduzir processos seletivos para posições em nossas unidades internacionais, adaptando estratégias de atração conforme o perfil local e alinhando-se à cultura;
  • Atuar como parceiro(a) estratégico(a) dos gestores, mantendo-os informados e engajados durante todo o processo;
  • Ministrar integrações para novos colaboradores, garantindo uma jornada de entrada acolhedora e alinhada à nossa cultura;
  • Realizar processos de admissão e acompanhar a avaliação de experiência dos novos talentos;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente as nossas unidades em todo o Brasil nos temas relacionados à seleção;
  • Atuar de forma estratégica nas ações de marca empregadora (employer branding), fortalecendo o posicionamento da empresa em universidades, fóruns, feiras de carreira, cursos técnicos e demais canais de relacionamento com candidatos;
  • Contribuir com iniciativas que fortaleçam nossa cultura e promovam um ambiente cada vez mais inclusivo;
  • Utilizar sistemas de recrutamento e seleção (ATS) para garantir organização e rastreabilidade dos processos;
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores da área (tempo de contratação, SLA de vagas, fontes de atração, entre outros), propondo melhorias contínuas nos processos e a melhor experiência para candidatos e gestores;
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de Atração e Seleção gerando insights para melhoria contínua dos processos e apoio à tomada de decisão.


Requisitos Necessários:

  • Graduação Completa em Psicologia;
  • Conhecimentos em condução de processos seletivos e entrevistas por competências;
  • Possuir CNH Cat. B e ter disponibilidade para viagens.


*Nossas oportunidades são abertas para todos os profissionais, sem distinção de raça, cor, gênero, idade, crença e deficiência (PCD)*

title: Talent Operations Specialist
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at


Role Summary

This role's primary responsibility will be to carry on talents through the selection process, by executing all the operational steps involved. Those might involve scheduling interviews, speaking and negotiating with candidates, reporting collected information and statuses, and interacting with internal stakeholders.

Besides the tasks execution the person in this role will also be pushed to think and work under the scalability mindset, delivering operational efficiency on the ground. The ideal candidate should be able to execute while challenging the status quo, automatizing repeatable processes, streamlining processes, optimizing cross-functional handoffs, reducing SLAs and improving talents’ experience.


Core Responsibilities

  • Operational Execution : Manage all candidate-related operational steps, including communication via email, WhatsApp, and phone; scheduling technical and client interviews; conducting non-technical interviews; coordinating availability; negotiating rates; and ensuring smooth onboarding transitions.
  • Stakeholder Communication : Provide clear, timely updates and handoffs through shared documents, chat channels, and meetings while keeping candidates informed, engaged, and aware of next steps and feedback throughout the process.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting : Collect, clean, and analyze operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities; monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service-level agreements (SLAs) to maintain high operational standards.
  • Process Optimization : Continuously evaluate and refine workflows to improve scalability and candidate experience, develop and document standard operating procedures (SOPs), and implement automation solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Bandwidth & Pipeline Management : Manage large candidate pipelines daily by effectively prioritizing tasks, coordinating with stakeholders, and maintaining consistent productivity and quality under high-volume conditions.
  • Organization & Documentation : Maintain structured, accurate, and up-to-date spreadsheets, trackers, and operational documentation to ensure data integrity and transparency across all processes.
  • Compliance & Risk Management : Adhere to company policies, process playbooks, and quality standards, while supporting audits and reporting efforts to ensure full compliance with organizational and industry regulations.
  • Adaptability & Collaboration : Operate effectively in dynamic, fast-paced environments by switching contexts seamlessly, collaborating across global time zones, and maintaining accountability and clear communication to meet deadlines.


Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s degree in, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Engineering, Human Resources or a related field.
  • Experience : 3–6 years at Operations within digital business, or Talent Operations, People Operations, Recruiting Operations, at a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Analytical Skills : Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, formulas, dashboards); ability to manage databases and process them into reports and insights.
  • Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English), with the ability to convey complex information clearly to both candidates and internal stakeholders.
  • Organization & Prioritization : Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, stakeholders, and competing priorities while maintaining high attention to detail.
  • Process Orientation : Demonstrated ability to identify inefficiencies, document workflows, and implement process improvements or automation initiatives.
  • Stakeholder Management : Skilled at partnering with recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver timely and accurate operational support.
  • Adaptability : Comfortable working across global time zones, shifting priorities, and high-volume pipelines in a dynamic, scaling environment.


Values

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

title: Especialista em SRE
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Você fará parte do time de SRE/DevSecOps responsável por uma plataforma de dados e inteligência artificial em arquitetura Cloud Native, base estratégica para diversos produtos da companhia.

Será um papel essencial na evolução técnica e cultural da infraestrutura, garantindo confiabilidade, escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência operacional.

A pessoa nessa posição liderará iniciativas de automação, observabilidade e resiliência, além de capacitar outras equipes a entregarem software com mais qualidade, agilidade e segurança.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Monitorar continuamente a saúde dos sistemas, criar alertas eficazes e garantir cobertura proativa de incidentes.
  • Responder rapidamente a incidentes críticos, coordenando mitigação, comunicação e resolução.
  • Gerir mudanças, atualizações e implantações com foco em segurança, estabilidade e disponibilidade.
  • Construir e manter pipelines, bibliotecas e automações para provisionamento, deploy e operação em ambientes Cloud de alta disponibilidade.
  • Estabelecer e garantir padrões de security by design em infraestrutura, código e dados.
  • Projetar e evoluir soluções de observabilidade ponta a ponta, integrando logs, métricas, traces e eventos.
  • Gerenciar e melhorar indicadores de confiabilidade (SLIs, SLOs, MTTR, MTTA).
  • Conduzir post-mortems blameless e implementar ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Influenciar decisões arquiteturais e operacionais visando resiliência, escalabilidade e custo eficiente.
  • Documentar padrões técnicos, playbooks e comunicar impactos técnicos em linguagem de negócio.
  • Definir prioridades estratégicas do backlog de SRE, equilibrando confiabilidade, velocidade de entrega, segurança e custos.
  • Apoiar auditorias, conformidade e governança de segurança em alinhamento com times de risco e compliance.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Domínio de conceitos avançados de SRE, DevSecOps e gestão de incidentes.
  • Automação de infraestrutura e pipelines em alto nível, utilizando Shell, Python, Go, Node.js ou Groovy.
  • Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade distribuída (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, ELK/Elastic Stack, Datadog, New Relic, OpenTelemetry).
  • Atuação sólida com Cloud pública (GCP, AWS ou equivalente), incluindo provisionamento, automação e otimização de custos.
  • Experiência em CI/CD e DevSecOps avançado, com ferramentas como Git/GitOps, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Maven, SonarQube/Cloud.
  • Proficiência em contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes) e Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, Chef).
  • Vivência com serviços de mensageria e data streaming como Kafka, Redis Streams, Google Pub/Sub, Dataflow.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, incluindo PostgreSQL, AloyDB, MySQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, BigQuery.
  • Experiência em gestão de incidentes e troubleshooting em sistemas complexos, utilizando PagerDuty, Opsgenie, StatusPage, Splunk ou equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento em segurança da informação, compliance e governança de ambientes cloud (LGPD, Privacy by Design, SAST/DAST, IAM, Secret Management).
  • Familiaridade com ambientes de alto volume de dados, tráfego e experiência com design resiliente.
  • Experiência ou interesse em DataOps/MLOps, atuando com pipelines de dados e IA em larga escala (desejável).
  • Background em arquitetura e desenvolvimento de software, com domínio de versionamento, APIs, microserviços e padrões REST/gRPC.
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban ou similares).
  • Uso de IA assistiva e ferramentas de produtividade como GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT ou similares (diferencial).
  • Capacidade de mentorar e influenciar tecnicamente outros times, promovendo cultura de automação, segurança e confiabilidade e fomentando a cultura de ownership sobre sistemas em produção.


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Certificações relevantes (AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, Security+).
  • Experiência com Service Mesh (Istio, Linkerd) e políticas de segurança zero-trust.
  • Conhecimento em FinOps e gestão de custos em ambientes distribuídos.
  • Experiência com blue/green deployments, canary releases e chaos engineering.
  • Experiência com padronização de deploys por templates (Helm/Kustomize).
  • Prática com observabilidade unificada via OpenTelemetry e tracing distribuído.
  • Vivência em construção de plataformas internas (IDP), uso de Backstage, automação de ambientes.
  • Inglês Intermediário-> Avançado


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

title: Acquisition Editor, Life Science
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

We are seeking an ambitious individual to join our team as an Acquisition Editor. In this role, you will focus on recruiting new authors and content for our Journal.


Responsibilities:

  • Identify and recruit new authors, guiding them through the manuscript submission process for JoVE Journal.
  • Contact potential Guest Editors and collaborate with them to build a Methods Collections, our version of a special issue.
  • Establish and maintain a strong network of scientists/journal authors to drive content acquisition and grow submission rates.
  • Collaborate with the peer review team to facilitate the publication of manuscripts.
  • Meet or exceed monthly acquisition targets.


Requirements:

  • A Ph.D. in the Life Sciences.
  • Fluent English written and verbal communication skills.
  • Results-driven, with an ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational, influencing and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with the publishing process is a plus.


Why Join JoVE?

  • You can expect compensation competitively placed within the local market, including unlimited bonus for manuscript acquisition.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and discovery.
  • Opportunity to work in a remote environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

  • Strong understanding of LATAM media ecosystem and regional communication styles.
  • Existing relationships with major tech and gaming outlets.
  • Language Skills :

  • A proactive communicator with high accountability and attention to detail.

O foco principal é garantir o carregamento ultrarrápido das páginas, melhorar as métricas de Core Web Vitals e aplicar as melhores práticas de SEO Técnico, resultando em melhor posicionamento nos mecanismos de busca e aumento nas taxas de conversão.


Principais Responsabilidades

1. Otimização de Performance:

- Analisar, diagnosticar e solucionar gargalos de performance no Front-End (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, imagens, fontes).

- Focar na melhoria contínua das métricas Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID/INP, CLS) e outras métricas de velocidade (TTFB, FCP, TTI).

- Implementar técnicas de otimização como code splitting, lazy loading, pré-carregamento de recursos (preloading/prefetching), compressão (Gzip/Brotli) e caching avançado.

2. SEO Técnico e Carregamento:

- Garantir a rastreabilidade (crawlability) e indexação eficiente das páginas por bots de mecanismos de busca.

- Otimizar a estrutura do DOM, o uso de HTML semântico e metatags.

- Trabalhar na renderização ideal (server-side, client-side ou híbrida/SSR) para equilibrar performance e SEO.

3. Monitoramento e Análise:

-Utilizar ferramentas como Google PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, WebPageTest, Google Search Console e ferramentas de RUM (Real User Monitoring) para monitorar e reportar a performance em ambientes de produção.

-Criar e manter dashboards de performance, identificando tendências e oportunidades de otimização.

4. Colaboração e Educação:

-Colaborar de perto com equipes de Design (UX/UI), Back-End e Marketing/SEO para garantir que as novas funcionalidades sejam lançadas com alta performance e aderência técnica.

• Otimização de Assets: Conhecimento profundo em otimização de imagens (WebP, AVIF, tag), font loading (FOIT, FOUT) e minificação de código.

• Ferramentas de Build/Bundling: Experiência com ferramentas como Webpack, Rollup ou Vite, configurando otimizações para produção.

• Infraestrutura/Rede: Entendimento de redes (HTTP/2, HTTP/3), Content Delivery Networks (CDN) e estratégias de cache no navegador e no servidor.

• SEO Técnico: Conhecimento em Sitemap, Robots.txt, canonicalização, dados estruturados (Schema.org) e experiências de usuário mobile.

title: Franchise Business Consultant - LATAM
description:
The Franchise Business Consultant – LATAM supports Master Franchise and Direct Franchise partners across Latin America by providing operational guidance, financial coaching, and training to drive performance while ensuring alignment with Gold’s Gym global standards. This role requires fluency in Portuguese and English and proficiency in Spanish to effectively collaborate across diverse markets in the region. The FBC conducts regular market visits, virtual consultations, and leads both in-person and online training sessions. This is a remote role based out of the Brasil. Frequent travel throughout Latin America—up to 50% or more—is required.


Responsibilities:


Franchise Support & Coaching

  • Serve as the primary operational liaison for Master Franchise and Direct Franchise owners, offering consultative support on day-to-day operations, financial performance, leadership development, and member experience.
  • Build strong, collaborative relationships across culturally and linguistically diverse markets, ensuring business strategies align with Gold’s Gym standards while adapting to local market needs.
  • Conduct regular check-ins and annual in-person site visits with each franchise location in the assigned LATAM territory.
  • Provide guidance and resources to drive operational excellence and regional growth.
  • Leverage KPI benchmarks, and digital platforms to monitor and support franchise performance.


Training & Leadership Development

  • Develop and deliver in-person and virtual training sessions in Portuguese (and Spanish where applicable) for franchisees and their teams, focusing on operational efficiency, member experience, and profitability.
  • Facilitate webinars, learning sessions, and peer collaboration forums to promote continuous learning and knowledge sharing in the LATAM market.
  • Lead onboarding programs for new franchisees and gym leaders, providing a strong foundation in Gold’s Gym systems, standards, and growth strategies.
  • Champion the rollout of corporate initiatives, tools, and new programs, ensuring cultural adaptation and consistent adoption across locations.


Operational Evaluations & Brand Standards

  • Perform standardized gym evaluations, operational audits, and brand assessments.
  • Ensure all LATAM locations remain compliant with system standards, brand guidelines, and operational policies.


Strategic Business & Financial Planning

  • Review and interpret financial reports (P&Ls, balance sheets, KPIs) to identify trends and coach franchisees on strategies for profitability and operational improvement.
  • Assist with strategic planning, forecasting, and staff planning tailored to the LATAM region.


Market Insights & System Collaboration

  • Conduct annual market reviews and monitor competitive activity in each territory.
  • Share benchmarking data, performance insights, and market intelligence with both franchisees and internal teams.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, technology, and development teams to align LATAM field strategies with broader corporate objectives.


Skills & Qualifications

title: Game Designer (Mid to Senior)
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil-based) 

Employment type: Full-time (CLT) 

Language: Portuguese (fluent), English (professional working proficiency)

Salary Range:  R$7K – R$12K

762 Interactive is looking for a Game Designer to join our studio and help bring to life Project Kingpin, an ambitious and fresh take on crime-strategy and management games. We’re searching for someone with strong gameplay instincts, creative systems thinking, and a passion for designing mechanics that are strategic, rewarding, and authentic. You’ll work across gameplay systems, economy, and progression to shape how players experience the world we are building. This role requires both hands-on design work and collaboration across disciplines.


This is a remote position.

Please do not apply if you do not have prior game development experience.  

In This Role You Will:

  • Design and document core gameplay systems, loops, and progression structures.
  • Balance player rewards, pacing, and progression using data and playtesting.
  • Write and maintain clear design documentation (GDDs, feature briefs, tuning sheets).
  • Collaborate closely with developers, artists, and production to prototype and refine mechanics.
  • Participate in playtests and iterate based on player feedback.
  • Contribute ideas across mission design, economy systems, and player experience.
  • Help define design processes and best practices as part of a growing studio.


What We are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in game design.
  • Proven experience with gameplay systems, progression, or balancing.
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to translate creative ideas into testable mechanics.
  • Proficiency with Excel/Sheets for tuning and balancing.
  • Knowledge of Unity editor & autonomy to use the scriptable objects
  • Clear, structured writing and documentation skills.
  • Can think and work creatively while taking the initiative to solve problems. 
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-discipline. 
  • Self-motivated, strong work ethic, and able to work independently. 
  • Drive towards professional growth. 
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency for daily communication with U.S. leadership.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with strategy / sim / management games is very welcome. 
  • UI/UX Design Experience.
  • Knowledge of C# in the Unity Engine.
  • Knowledge of AI behavior, or mission scripting.
  • Understanding of Unity implementation or prototyping workflows.
  • Interest in narrative-driven systems or branching gameplay.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary 
  • CLT Contract with Benefits (including Health Insurance, Monthly Meal Voucher, & Monthly Internet / Home Office Voucher)  
  • Remote-first culture 
  • Clear growth path: opportunities to advance your career as we scale the team and build the studio. 
  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of the studio and game from the ground up. 
  • Creative environment where your voice and ideas matter.

  • Residência ou Título em Pneumologia.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em regime PJ .

  • Suporte técnico e administrativo completo.

  • Estrutura moderna e ambiente de trabalho acolhedor.

description:
We’re Expanding Our Global Capital Agent Network – Join Magnum Equities as an Independent Capital Agent


Remote | Global | Commission-Based | #PrivateEquity #CapitalRaising #InvestmentOpportunities #CapitalAgent #Agent #Broker #InvestmentBanker #PrivateMarkets #VentureCapital #Entrepreneurship


Are you a capital introducer, private banker, independent dealmaker, ultra-networker, or connected investment professional looking to monetize your network?


Magnum is seeking experienced Capital Agents to join our global sourcing network. These independent agents will facilitate capital to Magnum Equities and earn 2% commission on successfully funded partnership capital placements, from fiat currency to crypto currency.


Capital Agent – Independent Investment Sourcing Partner


Location: Global | Remote

Full | Part-time or Side gig with your current job


Industry: You can be of any industry sector background, early/mid/or late in your career, having a capital network of partnership investment prospects that desire high ROI via profit share in Magnum’s global real estate and business equities assets growth forward, and large-scale social impact.


Commission: 2% of Capital Raised


About Magnum Equities


Magnum is foremost a mass capital investment partnership platform, capital raise platform for SME's, and mass social impact/empowerment powerhouse. Magnum's main pillars: Real Estate Assets Partners | Tech/Business Equity Partners | Precious Metals | Sukuk (Marabaha) enabling Shariah compliant capital placement investment from micro to macro capital partners, via “Magnum Equities Partnership Tokenization". Enabling globally democratized - low barrier to entry (min 50 Euros/token) - investment, empowering individuals to large institutional capital placement participation in Magnum’s global portfolio rather than being limited to only a specific single asset, optimizing short/medium/long term (3-5yrs), ROI (3X/5X/10X/100X/2500X+), and abatement of any singular asset downside. Magnum also empowers Capital Agents with lucrative revenue streams for their facilitated capital. These can be individuals, SF/MF Private offices, fund managers, capital management firms, institutional etc. Fiat currency, & crypto currency investment enabled.


Our global investors are significantly advantaged leveraging their purchase of Magnum’s RWA tokens as profit share rights in Magnum's aggregate global performance forward. Micro to Macro partnerships via fractional partnership profit share tokenization on blockchain via our RWA/PropTech blockchain/fintech partner portal.


Magnum’s innovative fractional partnership structure provides flexibility to vest capital across GCC/MENA/North America Strategic Growth region assets without requiring local RWA tokenization adoption. Magnum enables periodic ROI distributions based on portfolio-wide performance metrics via smart contracts.


Magnum’s cutting edge RWA tokenized profit share partnership model maintains investors’ blockchain-enabled transparency.


Magnum provides its profit share partners/investors with what entities such as Berkshire Hathaway have provided capital investors, except much more opportunity, scope, innovation integration, social impact, & mass low barrier of entry to participate - individually to institutionally.

With Magnum, whether your vested fractional profit share tokens are aligned with our entire Real Estate focused portfolio, or as accredited investor choosing from our globally located Cross-industry sector companies seeking to raise capital, or both, you’re not stuck with just one asset, gated entry points, or vague returns. It’s about real productive assets you can see, touch, and feel, as well as large-scale pan-global business equity positions. Partners get fractional profit share access to a massive diverse portfolio, smart contract-driven payouts, and a model built for transparency and real growth.


Magnum is foremost a global partnership investment platform that lets you own fractional profit share rights in real-world assets (Large Scale Real Estate and Cross-Industry Business Equity)—tokenized for transparency, diversification, and ease of access. Think of it as owning a piece of a global portfolio, without needing millions to get started. Magnum is also engineered to be a democratizing, equal opportunity, income/earnings empowerment platform for often displaced masses of global micro investors to institutional, that want to be associated with a mass legacy-driven, cutting edge investment and social impact platform that empowers and restores micro-investor hope, dignity, respect, income equality, standard of living, growth, and vision within an investment climate that has historically displaced the masses. Magnum levels the playing field, ensuring equal opportunity and low barrier to entry. Is it a global movement? We think so.


Who does Magnum serve


Our model supports everyone—from Micro partners/investors (global individuals) to UHNW, Single/Multi-Family Offices, Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Endowments | Foundation/Charitable | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Infrastructure Funds etc. while empowering all our capital agents.

  • Earn 2% on capital you raise – Simple!
  • Operate independently and flexibly, without exclusive commitment

  • Dedicated support: Capital partner relationship team and due diligence assistance

Who This Is For

title: Production Technician
description:
Position: Production Technician

Location: FPSO Marechal Duque de Caxias


About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have been a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and sustainable value to our stakeholders around the world.


Responsibilities

  • Perform regular rounds across the process plant to monitor system and equipment performance, ensuring stable operation and reporting any abnormal conditions.
  • Execute periodical verification and predictive/preventive maintenance of topside systems and equipment according to SOPs, permits, and supervisor’s instructions.
  • Execute first-line maintenance on process systems and equipment in accordance with CMMS work orders, daily checks, and supervisor’s instructions.
  • Conduct line-walk inspections to verify proper isolations before issuing or releasing Permit to Work (PTW).
  • Prepare systems and equipment (e.g., drain, depressurize, clean, purge) prior to handover to maintenance teams.
  • Support process start-up and shutdown procedures according to standard operating procedures (SOPs) and safety requirements.
  • Perform assigned activities, support third-party representatives, oversee jobs, or assist in emergency responses, following instructions from the direct line of report or the Incident On-Scene Commander, in compliance with relevant qualifications, training, competencies, and SOP requirements.


Requirements

  • Previous experience in the offshore oil and gas industry.
  • Valid offshore certifications and training courses.
  • Proactive attitude and good interpersonal behavior.
  • Strong teamwork spirit.
  • Intermediate English (mandatory).


Benefits

  • Meal and food allowances.
  • Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay).
  • Life Insurance.
  • Annual Bonus.
  • Private Pension Plan.
  • Childcare Allowance.


Note: This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

title: Desenvolvedor de integração

Seus desafios serão:


  • Projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de integração entre o SAP (ERP e IS-U HANA) e sistemas legados, utilizando ferramentas modernas de automação e orquestração.
  • Garantir que todas as integrações respeitem os padrões de segurança da informação, auditoria, criptografia e compliance regulatório.
  • Desenvolver e monitorar APIs, middlewares (SAP PI/PO, CPI, etc.), conectores e mensagerias (ex: Kafka, RabbitMQ), assegurando o funcionamento contínuo dos fluxos de dados.
  • Estabelecer boas práticas de versionamento, CI/CD, segregação de ambientes, testes automatizados e rollback.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de BASIS, segurança, infraestrutura, desenvolvimento ABAP/Java e fornecedores externos.
  • Apoiar o controle de acesso a serviços de integração, utilizando mecanismos como OAuth2, certificados digitais, SAML, etc.
  • Monitorar, diagnosticar e resolver falhas nos pipelines de integração com foco em resiliência.
  • Documentar fluxos, endpoints, dependências e procedimentos operacionais.


O que é necessário você ter:


  • Ensino superior completo em áreas de TI.
  • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas DevSecOps aplicadas a projetos SAP e/ou integrações corporativas.
  • Domínio de CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em SAP PI/PO, SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), API Management, IDoc, RFC/BAPI, ODATA e WebServices.
  • Experiência com integração segura (HTTPS, JWT, certificados, SSO, firewalls).
  • Conhecimento em containers (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes, OpenShift).
  • Experiência com sistemas de mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).
  • Automação de testes e validações em integrações.
  • Conhecimento em monitoramento de logs e métricas (ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, etc.).
  • Familiaridade com ambientes SAP híbridos (cloud/on-premise).
  • Conhecimento prévio de integrações com sistemas de utilities (ex: sistemas de medição, CRM legado, gestão de redes, etc.).
  • Experiência com SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

title: Chief Executive Officer
description:
Hartmann Young is proud to be partnered with a leading dietary supplement manufacturer serving both domestic and international markets across South America. The company is recognised for its strong scientific foundation, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and commitment to innovation in nutritional products. With a diversified customer base spanning consumer health, functional foods, and nutraceutical brands, the business is poised for a new phase of strategic growth and international expansion.


As Chief Executive Officer , you will lead the company’s strategic, operational, and commercial direction across South America. You will be responsible for driving profitability, operational excellence, and long-term growth, ensuring the business continues to innovate and compete at the forefront of the dietary supplement manufacturing industry.


Key Responsibilities

  • Define and implement the company’s strategic vision and long-term business objectives across Brazil, Chile, Argentina, and other key South American markets.
  • Oversee all business operations, including manufacturing, R&D, sales, quality, and regulatory functions.
  • Lead organisational transformation to enhance efficiency, scalability, and market responsiveness.
  • Drive revenue growth through new partnerships, customer acquisition, and product innovation.
  • Ensure operational excellence, quality assurance, and compliance with international standards (GMP, ISO, ANVISA, etc.).
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across all departments.
  • Represent the company in strategic alliances, investor relations, and regional industry events.
  • Work closely with the board and investors to deliver sustainable financial and market performance.


Key Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Life Sciences, Engineering, or related field (MBA preferred).
  • 15+ years of leadership experience in dietary supplements, nutraceuticals, or pharmaceutical manufacturing .
  • Proven track record in executive management, business transformation, or scaling operations across Latin America.
  • Deep understanding of supplement manufacturing processes, regulatory frameworks, and supply chain dynamics.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen with experience leading P&L responsibility.
  • Bilingual or multilingual (Portuguese, Spanish, and English proficiency highly desirable).
  • Dynamic leadership style with a focus on innovation, growth, and organizational excellence.
